title: Noncommutative infinitary semigroups
summary: Various kinds of infinitary operations satisfying forms of associativity have been considered in the literature by various authors, including A. Tarski, C. Karp, J. H. Conway, D. Krob, N. Bedon, and C. Rispal. Applications include the arithmetics of binary relations, quasigroups, and automata theory, We present a general definition for an infinitary noncommutative partial semigroup; the definition extends and encompasses all the previous notions.
